repos.name: mikehasa/agentacct
repos.description: See what your coding agents did and what it cost. Breaks each task down into work steps — tools used, files changed, tests run, time and tokens spent. Local-first dashboard for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and more. No login, no telemetry.
repos.one_liner: A local-first observability and cost-tracking dashboard specifically designed for AI coding agents.
bullets: Built with Python to provide granular visibility into agentic workflows.
Tracks key performance metrics including token consumption, latency, and execution costs per task.
Provides a detailed audit trail of tool usage, file modifications, and test results.
Ideal for engineering teams managing AI agent budgets and debugging agentic decision-making processes.
repos.img_alt: agentacct tui — live usage, cost, provider rate-limit bars, and recent sessions with per-session weekly-plan-cost estimates
repos.img2_alt: agentacct tui session detail — the per-step work ledger with pass/fail check evidence and a weekly-plan-cost estimate

repos.name: simonlin1212/vibe-astock
repos.description: A 股短线复盘看板：涨停池·连板梯队·龙虎榜·板块资金一屏看完，赚钱效应/晋级率/梯队断层/情绪周期等派生指标纯计算直出（不经过 AI），AI 只把数据串成能读的盘面研判。全本地运行，可用 Claude/Codex 订阅免 API key。| A-share short-term daily-review dashboard: derived sentiment metrics computed locally, AI only writes the narrative. No API key needed.
repos.one_liner: A high-performance local dashboard for A-share market sentiment analysis and short-term trading review.
bullets: Uses a hybrid approach: deterministic mathematical computation for market metrics and AI for narrative synthesis.
Calculates complex sentiment indicators like 'limit-up' pools, ladder tiers, and capital flow without relying on external API calls.
Supports local execution with Claude/Codex, ensuring data privacy and zero API costs.
Designed for quantitative traders who need real-time, actionable insights into market sentiment cycles.

repos.name: Flaminis/Dalaran
repos.description: Dalaran — Apache-2.0, robotics-first visualization and data infrastructure for multimodal time-series. ROS 2 native, reads existing .rrd recordings. A hard fork of Rerun.
repos.one_liner: A robotics-first, high-performance visualization and data infrastructure tool for multimodal time-series analysis.
bullets: Built in Rust as a hard fork of Rerun, optimized for high-throughput data streams.
Native ROS 2 integration allows for seamless ingestion of complex robotics and sensor data.
Supports reading existing .rrd recordings, making it highly compatible with legacy data pipelines.
Provides a robust infrastructure for visualizing time-series data, critical for financial modeling and high-frequency data analysis.
